notes.title: Version 1.2.6 : Fall Fits
notes.content:
[p]Version 1.2.6 will be submitted for reviews Sunday September 21, Patch Notes Are Here Now!

Even better than the previous sale, the base price across all 3 stores is now permanently reduced by 57%!! There's no time like the present to Start Healing!

This update is small but exciting, with the usual background additions of course... But now, Crew Fits are unlocked for everyone even new players, with a new Halloween fit for scaring the patients! Look spooky while trick and treating!

Other project has been moving forward, minus a lot of day job time creep... There are some pretty neat core systems in place making the magic possible, crafting and questing being a couple major functional components, my test guy is wearing some of the first armor set... Still a ton of content mountains to climb, some things to code like more resources, combat, travel to other places... So much left to do, I have seriously considered smaller projects along the way, or maybe more HTS than just keeping the app stores up to date. No plan changes yet tho, it's been a few days off getting this update ready, back to it in the coming week, DRGS and D4 permitting.

Thanks for playing![/p][h1]
Heal The Survivors Patch Notes[/h1][h2]App Version 1.2.6 : Fall Fits[/h2][p]2025-09-15 - 2025-09-20[/p][p][/p][h3]Customization[/h3][list][*][p]added 3 new seasonal backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]unlocked Crew Fit selector for everyone, and added a new free seasonal crew fit![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2.5 : Summer Fun
notes.content:
[p]Version 1.2.5 has been submitted for reviews, Patch Notes Are Here Now![/p][p][/p][p]HTS will be joining the Steam Summer Sale on June 26, with matching sales in the mobile app stores as well! Two exciting new updates to get you through the dog days of Summer! Ruff![/p][p][/p][p]This update is admittedly small, just something new and seasonal to go with the sale. In other news, The Next Game is 4+ weeks along now, I have been sticking to my training regimen, every day I try to learn or read something new about Godot, and also about Pixel Art, as well as make progress on The Game code and content. I even got the ok to go nuts on my udemy account, I'll be watching a bunch of interesting art/godot courses there shortly once I run out of Godot Reference pages to read. I doubt there will be any pre hype, much like with HTS I want to drop it all at once when it's ready, with even less post-release work necessary I hope. I have grand visions (delusions) that I don't really expect to finish this year, I realize I said plan everything, I have the general path in mind, everything will get reiterated to my satisfaction, and my mantra for content so far has been "crank it up to 11" we will see how far i push that policy... for half a clue of reward if you read this far, i'll tell you I have an animated main menu, animated character creation, world generation with multiple layers foreground and background, and parallax background sky/caves, all working, about to start adding grass to the dirt... ;) (update later : grass is growing, hills are rolling, more hills art iteration or inventory coding today...)

notes.title: Version 1.2.4 : Exposé
notes.content:
Version 1.2.4 is submitted for reviews, Patch Notes Are Here! This patch features tons of Unlock and Statistics data and information that was never available on screen before! Every percentage change, every tick of regen, every point of power in every tool, is now displayed on screen, either when Leveling Up or in the pause menu. I still didn't spell out which skill buffs which calculation, but the descriptions are meant to give you a clue (hint : beefcake increases Player Sleepiness (HP) max value). Even the Tool Evolutions show you how much power is added!

As mentioned previously, this is the last "Scheduled" patch I have planned for now. This entire game was based on "no plans" (no you don't say), this started as a Godot tutorial that got me so excited, I had to bring it to release. I want to start working on "The Next Game", though I honestly do not have a specific plan set in stone yet, making plans for it is definitely going to be part of the process, it will be much less "flying by the seat of my pants" than this game has been.

The first steps include More Tutorials and learning, and I suspect it's possible I will learn a thing or two that I just have to add to HTS. So this game is not Ded, I see Steam is marking some early access games i have as "not updated in 2 years", I don't think I want that label on this game. So while updates will probably "slow down", I don't imagine they will ever stop completely, as long as I still draw breath.

I have ideas for HTS 2.0 some day, but they will require much content creation, we're talking all new art and music across the baord. I do not guarantee I will ever put that much effort back into this, but if I wanted to "redo" some things, I made everything knowing I left "room for improvement" (what a shocker said my dayjob coworkers). Oh and while I stopped thinking about advertising, I am considering sales and price changes this summer... I bet you get at least one update along those lines ;)

As always, if you ever find a bug or feature you don't like, please report them to dev@goodguydev.net We thank you for playing Heal The Survivors!

notes.title: Version 1.2.3 : Rando Nando
notes.content:
Version 1.2.3 is being submitted for reviews today, Patch Notes Now! This patch is all about Randos, in the form of new buttons and selections in almost every screen and menu, to add a bunch of Randomization to the game. Play random crew, visit random incidents, and let Nando choose your upgrades and levelups for you!

In one week, it will be the one year anniversary of me starting this project. 6+ months to release, and 5+ months of biweekly upgrades, has made this game everything I ever imagined it would be and more. That Being Said... I am low on ideas that can be done in a couple weeks, I have a couple unimplemented plans, but they would almost certainly mean I call it HTS 2.0 if I added that much content. Reaction was mostly favorable, but lack of advertising and promotion means there was almost no response past direct word of mouth from me to friends.

As much fun as it has been, it is time to focus on something else soon. This game is not Ded, the first thing on my agenda is learning more Godot tricks, it's fully possible I will find things I can't wait for later, I will have to try them out in HTS to improve it. My main intent is to start thinking about "The Next Game", with wholly different themes, genres, and plans to be expected.

Of course Bugs will always be fixed if any are found in the future, please report them to dev@goodguydev.net I know one got out with Career Mode, then one of the stores tried to tell me they had a crash last push, uh no try it again please... I think it was more about the dreaded "A" word, once you get to 100 of those in a store, Do Not use that word in your patch notes people! :P <3

notes.title: It's Go Time!
notes.content:
Heal The Survivors will be available on STEAM for PC & Mac on November 27!

Eager players may find it today on mobile stores, but for full Achievement Integration, the Steam version will be worth the wait. This project was kept Top Secret until this week, the first playtest reactions will certainly bring a Balance Patch soon after release. Until then, we thank you for wishlisting or just checking out our silly little game!

For example, tonight I increased Stethoscope tool distance 3x, based on initial reports of the first level being a bit hard, for non gamer testers so far. I knew it was a bit difficult for a starting tool, but I really want to start with that, now more range should make it more usable. I also added a Patch Notes button on the Options Menu, gave it full controller/mobile support, and added these updates as the first notes. That version may not be available for a few days on mobile, but all of these updates will be included in version 1.0.0, which will be posted to Steam by Release Day or shortly after.

I will continue updating this game both in Balance and Features for the immediate future, day job and project interest permitting... I promise not to start my Second Game until Summer 2025 ;)

Updated 11/22 : spent the past week making mobile store achievements work sorry no exclusives where code allows... the same Balance patch 0.9.8 is now uploaded as Release Day build for Steam PC / Mac!
